entities.summary: Andrey Nikolayevich Kovalchuk is a Russian sculptor. He holds the title of People's Artist of the Russian Federation and is the winner of the Moscow City Hall Prize for Literature and the Arts (1999) and the Russian Federation Government Prize for Culture (2005).
